build_grasp_motion_planner: build a SimpleGraspMotionPlanner instance with a HelloStretchKinematics robot and pregrasp height
plan_to_grasp_trajectory: plan a full grasp trajectory from a grasp pose and initial robot configuration
create_pregrasp_waypoint: create a pregrasp waypoint at the top of the robot arc using initial config
solve_inverse_kinematics_grasp: solve inverse kinematics for a grasp pose using the robot manip_ik method
compute_standoff_position: compute a standoff position above the grasp pose with configurable z standoff distance
